newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads two for attempted rape.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads two for attempted rape.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Saturday beheaded two Saudi men convicted of attempted rape, Saudi state-television reported.
An interior ministry statement carried by the television said the two men "got drunk, broke into a house and attempted to rape its female owner at gunpoint."
The beheadings in the capital Riyadh bring the number of people executed in the conservative kingdom this year to 35.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
